scope: Bounded public-only local request/result codecs and CPU-worker packet APIs under an existing single-use launch guard. No network format, wallet-witness API, new C ABI, autonomous executable, service transport or durable lease-to-OS supervisor.

native_validation.ignored_explanation: Six CPU fixture checks run explicitly. Three subprocess helpers run through their parent tests. Packet-driven generation and the existing fresh raw-node replay run separately under the proof controller. Earlier direct CPU generation is not rerun here.
checks: Six explicit CPU fixture checks: existing job/store/journal/worker checks plus packet pair/empty preparation and two real merge-child verifications
Rustfmt, diff check and complete source archive comparison
coverage: Canonical encoding, truncation/trailing data, count/length bounds before copying, canonical fields, operation geometry and ordered contiguous child statements.
Exact immutable assignment key, resources, expected profile/construction/chain, semantic job identity and artifact manifests.
Launch binding rejects wrong encoded process key/resources even when an opaque launch token hashes that packet.
CPU preparation verifies supplied wallet/node proofs against external registry and expected statements before large proving allocations.
Bounded result decoding binds the owner's original assignment and exact request, but returns only UnverifiedResult; well-formed wrong-job proof bytes fail subsequent owner CPU verification.
Worker-reported timings/cache counters are observational, not authority for acceptance, resource release or job eligibility.
native_validation.merge_fixture_scope: Setup reads retained pinned wallet fixtures to construct the expected DAG and reuses the known eight-wallet root at two ordered ranges. The worker receives/verifies two root proofs only. Repeated spends are not host-eligible; no 16-transaction proof, throughput or archive-pruning qualification is claimed.

real_proof.timing_scope: Packet decoding/binding and input verification; shared proving/setup/cleanup; result decode; revocation/idle checks; independent owner CPU verification and durable acceptance; output file publication. Initial fixture loading/admission/launch issuance excluded. Serialization metric is node-codec time, not all result-envelope work. No recovery replay or complete post-seal measurement in this trial.
real_proof.cleanup: No live spill mappings before result acknowledgement. Test-held launch guard blocks idle acquisition until proving/cleanup finishes and guard is dropped. Owner CPU-verifies and journals acceptance before resource ledger is empty. Synchronous test inside existing bounded experiment controller, not an autonomous OS worker supervisor.

Wrong wallet order and mutated proof bytes rejected.
independent_replay.scope: Raw node replay, not a recovered request/response transport or full-block root audit.
